detailed_description:
The target video is a silent, handheld live-action first-person POV phone recording in the style of an amateur walk-through, shot on the iPhone rear 1x main camera in 9:16 vertical format at 60fps, with natural walking micro-shake, realistic sensor noise, and deep focus throughout so every scene stays crisp edge to edge; the whole film advances through hard jump cuts with no transitions, no visible phone, no subtitles, and no watermark, with no narration, no human voice, and no music.
[Shot 1] The POV camera holds in front of a black marble tombstone in a night cemetery. <Subject 1>, the marigold solar ground light matching <Picture 1> with eight orange marigold flowers, thirteen three-dimensional black-and-orange monarch butterflies and forty-nine warm LEDs, glows with soft warm orange light among several lit ground lights planted on the grass in front of the stone. The marble surface reflects the warm glow, and a small memorial portrait with colorful lace trim, a lit tall glass candle, and scattered marigold petals rest before the tombstone. <Subject 2>'s right hand, marked with a realistic tribal tattoo on his tan-wheat skin, enters the frame from below and rubs the inscription on the frosted marble with the back of the hand; throughout the film only his left and right hands appear, with no extra limbs. The hand produces a soft scraping friction against the stone while a gentle night breeze passes.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, a hard cut to a daytime close-up. In bright sunlight, <Subject 2>'s right hand grips <Subject 1> and lifts it slightly toward the camera, filling the frame with the lit petal structure and the three-dimensional black-and-orange monarch butterflies, keeping the exact product appearance of <Picture 1>. The shot holds deep focus on the hand's realistic skin texture as the hand produces a dry, physical rubbing sound against the rod.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, a hard cut to a night walk-through in scene A. Night has fallen over a corner of a Texas farm, where a muddy old green pickup truck sits with a yellow dog lying beside one wheel. The handheld POV camera walks past and shows <Subject 1> planted in the mud, its warm light faintly refracting across a puddle. Night frogs croak and the yellow dog breathes audibly as the camera keeps moving.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, a hard cut to a night walk-through in scene B. The camera arrives at a second family setting, a courtyard with a wooden dining table and an old parasol, and walks between <Subject 1> lights planted in the soil on both sides of the table. Wind rattles the parasol overhead while the warm lights sway slightly in the grass.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, a hard cut to a night walk-through in scene C. Indoors, an altar table holds a painted skull and Day of the Dead bread, and the camera shows <Subject 1> placed in a pottery jar beside the table. Its warm light pulses in a slow breathing gradient and holds still on the final frame as the 10-second video ends, with only a quiet, low indoor room tone underneath.

overall_soundscape:
A continuous night breeze and low nocturnal outdoor ambience underpin the first four scenes, giving way to a quiet indoor room tone in the final scene, with natural, subtle hand-and-surface contact sounds carried through the video.
